source_family.creator: Kay Lousberg / KayKit
source_family.title: KayKit Character Pack: Adventurers
source_family.required_page_regex: fully rigged and animated|CC0 Licensed|Licensed under CC0
source_family.source_description: Immutable KayKit Adventurers direct FBX technical inputs pinned to historical SHA256 identities. GitHub revision archive does not contain the LFS FBX payloads, so hosted intake downloads the exact raw FBX endpoints individually. Raw bytes are never admitted directly to UE4; only a different normalized derivative SHA may proceed.

source_policy.derivative_identity_rule: Normalized FBX SHA256 must differ from raw source SHA256 before any UE4 admission.

normalization_contract.provenance: source entry + source SHA256 + normalized SHA256 + Blender version

generated_uv_policy.trigger: source mesh has zero UV layers
generated_uv_policy.method: Blender Smart UV Project during deterministic normalization

hosted_deformation_readiness.evidence_boundary: Static deformation readiness only; no visual deformation acceptance.

ue4_hard_gate: linked USkeleton via USkeletalMesh::GetSkeleton() is valid
evidence_boundary: Technical winner is exact-head UE4.27 evidenced on Wave2 run #3. Deformation/retarget/runtime/PIE/device/rendered-visual/FPS acceptance remains pending.

latest_hosted_baseline.diagnosis: Rigify ORG/MCH/DEF control skeleton exported wholesale; direct FBX candidate also has catastrophic zero-weight ratio.
latest_hosted_baseline.root_fix: Blender export deform bones only and reject zero-weight ratio above 0.35 before self-hosted UE4.

physics_asset_gate.rationale: PhysicsAsset auto-generation can be absent on small-bone rigs and is not authoritative for skeletal import validity.

latest_technical_winner.physics_asset_note: UE4 reported small-bone auto-generation warning; separate sanity gate, not skeletal technical rejection.

hosted_deformation_preflight.self_hosted_reservation_rule: UE4 job skipped when hosted selected_count is zero.
hosted_deformation_preflight.candidate_failure_policy: Reject asset-quality failures per candidate, record evidence, continue bounded hosted sweep. Infrastructure failures remain fail-closed.

latest_failed_deformation_evidence.exact_log: required deform joints have no weighted vertex influence: head,left_foot,left_forearm,left_hand,left_shin,left_thigh,left_upper_arm,pelvis,right_foot,right_forearm,right_hand,right_shin,right_thigh,right_upper_arm,spine
latest_failed_deformation_evidence.forensic_fbx_result: weighted skin clusters confined to torso families; required head/limb families unweighted

latest_hosted_failure.cause: GitHub revision archive contains textures/GLB but not the repository's FBX/LFS payloads; archive-based extractor therefore found zero .fbx/.blend character sources.
latest_hosted_failure.disposition: Use immutable raw.githubusercontent FBX endpoints for Rogue/RogueHooded/Knight and verify their historical SHA256 identities before normalization.

ci_efficiency_contract.unreal_delta_base: previous PR head on synchronize, PR base only as fallback
ci_efficiency_contract.dedicated_human_lane: generic Unreal build must inherit/skip when only Human Wave2 pipeline files changed
ci_efficiency_contract.render_delta_classifier: self-hosted Shire capture skipped only when visual-impact delta is absent and previous-head render workflow is green
ci_efficiency_contract.render_transitive_proof: If immediate parent has no green render, nearest green first-parent ancestor may be inherited only when Source/Config/SourceAssets/uproject/capture/import visual-content paths are unchanged.

next_source_transition.historical_raw_policy: Raw rejected Rogue/Knight exact SHA payloads are never sent directly to UE4 again.
next_source_transition.normalized_derivative_policy: A distinct normalized FBX SHA may proceed only after hosted weighted-joint/deformation pass and unchanged UE4 hard gates.
